mapper.select: SELECT post_no, writer_email, nickname, category, title, content, ai_summary, view_count, comment_count, like_count, del_flag, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_community_post WHERE post_no = #{postNo} AND del_flag = false
SELECT image_no, post_no, file_name, video, ord FROM tbl_community_post_image WHERE post_no = #{postNo} ORDER BY ord
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_community_post (writer_email, nickname, category, title, content) VALUES (#{writerEmail}, #{nickname}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content})
INSERT INTO tbl_community_post_image (post_no, file_name, video, ord) VALUES (#{postNo}, #{fileName}, #{video}, #{ord})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_community_post_image WHERE post_no = #{postNo} AND file_name = #{fileName}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_community_post SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, ai_summary = #{aiSummary}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_no = #{postNo}
